stack_sequence_fields: stack a list of identically nested dicts into a single nested object with stacked numpy arrays
unstack_sequence_fields: convert a struct of batched numpy arrays into a list of individual unbatched structs
fast_map_structure: apply a function across corresponding leaves of multiple nested structures without error checking
broadcast_structures: broadcast scalar values into nested structures matching the shape of a reference nested argument
tree_map: create a tree-mapped version of a function that applies across nested structure leaves automatically
